title: Kolmogorov--Arnold against bounded translations
abstract: arXiv:2608.30710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historically originating from Hilbert's 13th problem, the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem (KART) has recently experienced a major revitalisation through its applications to neural networks, specifically Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs). While the exact representation is well established, its stability under continuous adversarial perturbations of the hidden layer remains a critical open question. In this paper, we investigate the robustness of KART against bounded adversarial translations. We provide an explicit, self-contained, and constructive proof of an approximate representation using fixed, piecewise linear inner functions. Crucially, our construction employs a single outer function that remains invariant for all summands and is independent of the specific adversarial translation, provided its maximum bound is known a priori.

translated_title: Kolmogorov–Arnold 表示定理对抗有界平移
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理（KART）历史上起源于希尔伯特第十三问题，近年来通过其在神经网络中的应用——特别是 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KANs）——经历了重大复兴。尽管精确表示已被很好地确立，但其在隐层连续对抗扰动下的稳定性仍是一个关键的开放问题。本文研究了 KART 对有界对抗平移的鲁棒性。我们利用固定的分段线性内函数，给出了一个近似表示的显式、自包含且构造性的证明。至关重要的是，我们的构造采用单一的外函数，该外函数对所有加数保持不变，并且只要对抗平移的最大界是先验已知的，该外函数就与具体的对抗平移无关。
tldr: 本文证明了 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理对有界对抗平移具有鲁棒性，并给出了使用固定分段线性内函数与单一外函数的近似表示的显式构造性证明。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the robustness of the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem against bounded adversarial translations, providing an explicit constructive proof of an approximate representation using fixed piecewise linear inner functions and a single outer function independent of the specific translation.
